import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
    
    d = x / y
    ans = 1e7
    a = 1
    b = 1
    eps = 1e-25
    
    if y <= b:
        print(f"{x}/{y}")
        return
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        a1 = math.floor(d * i)
        a2 = math.ceil(d * i)
        
        diff1 = abs(d - a1 / i)
        if diff1 < ans - eps:
            ans = diff1
            a = a1
            b = i
        
        diff2 = abs(a2 / i - d)
        if diff2 < ans - eps:
            ans = diff2
            a = a2
            b = i
    
    print(f"{a}/{b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
